YtDlp.//: Cache/staging are resolved under MediaRoot (public/demo-tracks), so five parents climb to the repo-root media/ folder, which is git-ignored and never served by the static web client. ExecutablePath and FfmpegLocation resolve from PATH; override machine-specific paths with YtDlp__ExecutablePath, YtDlp__FfmpegLocation, or YtDlp__JsRuntimes__0 (see README) or dotnet user-secrets instead of editing this committed file.
